items.title: Woman sends legal notice to actor Balu Varghese over alleged sexual misbehaviour
items.summary: A woman has sent a legal notice to actor Balu Varghese seeking a written undertaking and apology for alleged sexual misbehaviour at a private gathering. The notice, which details the incident, states that the alleged act constitutes a serious violation of bodily autonomy, dignity, privacy and personal security. “Unwelcome physical contact of the nature complained of cannot be justified by familiarity, friendship, participation in a game, the location of the gathering or any purported misunderstanding,” the notice reads. Balu Varghese began his career as a child actor in the 2005 Dileep-starrer Chanthupottu . He rose to popularity after his performance in the film Honey Bee (2015). Since then, he has appeared in over 40 films, including blockbusters like Jan.E.Man and Manjummel Boys. TNM spoke to three other women who are from the same film circle, connected through mutual friends. These women alleged that Balu has misbehaved with them also. The woman who sent the legal notice told TNM that the incident, which happened recently, left her deeply disturbed and enraged. “It happened underwater, while playing a friendly game.
